Shiny bindings for the interactive 3D viewer

Source: R/view-3d.R
view_3d-shiny.Rd

Place a viewer in a Shiny user interface and render a reactive expression returning view_3d(). In a module, pass ns("scene") to view3dOutput() and assign output$scene inside shiny::moduleServer(). Camera updates arrive in input$scene_camera; selected data keys arrive in input$scene_selected. Shiny supplies the widget identifier, so view_3d() can leave elementId at its default.

Usage

view3dOutput(outputId, width = "100%", height = "400px")

renderView3d(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE)

Arguments

outputId

Output identifier, namespaced in a module's user interface.

width, height

CSS dimensions, default "100%" and "400px".

expr

An expression returning a ggplot3d_view htmlwidget.

env

Environment in which to evaluate expr.

quoted

Whether expr is already quoted.

Value

view3dOutput() returns an HTML output container. renderView3d() returns a Shiny render function.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("htmlwidgets", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ui <- shiny::fluidPage(view3dOutput("scene"))
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    output$scene <- renderView3d({
      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg, z = hp)) +
        geom_point_3d() + coord_3d()
      view_3d(p, panel = 1)
    })
  }
  app <- shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
